Charlotte, NC, November 6, 2017 — Charlie Company Media of Charlotte, NC, partnered with Butterfleye, a leader in 100% wire-free security cameras that incorporate facial recognition and advanced detection for small businesses, for its Member Benefits Program. Butterfleye believes in smart solutions to protect business owners.

Small businesses that purchase from Butterfleye have access to a full suite of features that helps them improve the overall security of their business while giving meaningful insights. Each product pack offers a full-HD wireless security camera with the ability to link to a mobile app, free connection to the cloud, motion and sound sensors with live alerts, as well as an online analytics package that is able quantify how many people entered the business, at what times they entered and where they went within the business.

Charlie Company Media and Butterfleye agree that a security system with the ability to operate during internet and power outages makes it the most reliable security option for small business owners. Butterfleye and Charlie Company Media both believe in smart security solutions that are simple to set up, simple to use and unobtrusive in a business owner’s day-to-day.

About Charlie Company Media

Charlie Company Media is a division of Charlie Company Holdings, Inc., one of the nation’s largest media companies. Charlie Company Media is a digital marketing and solutions organization that specializes in creating the total web presence small businesses need to reach their online audience. Currently, Charlie Company Media serves 11,000+ clients on a month-to-month basis. Visit www.charliecompanymedia.com for more information.

About Butterfleye

Butterfleye, founded in 2015, provides full-HD wireless cameras to home and small business owners. Butterfleye believes in smart solutions to protect people, their homes, their businesses and their privacy. Butterfleye developed security platforms that combine activity-based recording, facial recognition and advanced technology to decide when to record and when to disarm, placing their products at the intersection of security and privacy. To learn more, visit Butterfleye, now Ooma’s website!
